answer_metrics.exclusion_leakage_rate: policy-excluded retrieved IDs / all retrieved IDs
answer_metrics.harmful_unsupported_claim_rate: potentially harmful unsupported claims / all assessed claims

citation_metrics.citation_completeness: cited adjudicated evidence / all required evidence
citation_metrics.citation_precision: cited adjudicated evidence / all cited evidence
citation_metrics.exact_dose_accuracy: exact value, unit, interval and route assessment

operations_metrics.cost_load: sum and mean using the recorded price-list timestamp
operations_metrics.stability_top10_jaccard: pairwise Jaccard over repeated runs per question

reporting_constraints: No synthetic_draft item is an independent clinical gold label.
Report denominators and confidence intervals with human-adjudicated results.
No-evidence means only no sufficient evidence in the released snapshot after full fallback.
